::: {.hero}
Seven short position papers were accepted to GUGOG. Camera-ready versions are
hosted here. Submissions are **non-archival**, and copyright remains with the
authors.
:::

## Presented at the Workshop {#presented-papers}

Six of the accepted papers will be presented as talks on **November 9, 2026**
(see the [schedule](index.qmd#schedule)).

::: {#presented}
:::

## Also Accepted {#also-accepted-papers}

These submissions were accepted, but their authors are not able to attend in
person, and we are unable to support hybrid presentations. They will not be
given a talk slot, but their camera-ready versions are included here.

::: {#also-accepted}
:::
